takeaways.text: Paid net additions were 13.12M — Netflix's largest Q4 ever, versus 7.66M a year ago — taking paid memberships to 260.28M as paid sharing and the ad-supported plan kept converting borrowers into members.
takeaways.title: A record fourth quarter for sign-ups

takeaways.text: Operating income rose to $1,496M from $550M a year ago — a 16.9% margin versus 7.0% — on revenue upside and lower-than-planned spending; full-year 2023 operating margin reached 21%, ahead of Netflix's 20% target.
takeaways.title: Margins jumped as spending lagged

takeaways.text: EPS of $2.11 includes a $239M non-cash unrealized loss from remeasuring euro-denominated debt as the dollar weakened in the quarter; even so, net income was $938M, up from just $55M a year ago.
takeaways.title: Currency noise cut into EPS

verdict: Netflix added a record 13.1M members in the quarter as paid sharing kept paying off, lifting revenue 12% to $8.8B and net income to $938M.
